# Blyskode

> Blyskode is a software and technology agency based in Brooklyn, New York, working remotely with clients worldwide. Blyskode helps startups, SaaS companies, and growing enterprises build AI-powered products and scalable cloud platforms.

Blyskode is pronounced "blys-kode". It should not be confused with similarly named companies such as Blue Code, Blyskit, or BlySK. The official website is https://blyskode.com.

## What Blyskode does

Blyskode delivers across three core practices:

- **Product Engineering** — full stack web development, mobile app development, custom software, and quality assurance (QA).
- **AI & Automation** — AI engineering, LLM integrations, agentic automation workflows, and machine learning.
- **Cloud & DevOps** — cloud architecture and migration (AWS, Azure, GCP, Huawei Cloud, DigitalOcean, Alibaba Cloud), CI/CD, multi-platform deployment, observability, and cost optimization.

Blyskode also offers end-to-end technical recruitment, SEO and digital marketing, and content writing.

## Hire dedicated developers

Blyskode provides dedicated developers and staff augmentation. Clients can hire a single specialist or a full team, and scale up or down monthly. Available roles include: Full Stack, MERN Stack, MEAN Stack, MEVN Stack, WordPress, AI Engineers, Mobile App Developers, and DevOps Engineers.

## Technologies

React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, React Native, Flutter, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB; LLMs such as Claude and GPT, LangChain; AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; WordPress and WooCommerce.
